subject: Request: one-off sandbox runway + SLA variance for Arboretum Labs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@arboretum.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox runway + SLA variance request for Arboretum Labs

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Arboretum’s integration looks like a strong fit for our healthcare track and the engineering team is excited about the performance profile. To keep momentum I'd like to propose a one-off arrangement so Arboretum can finish an end-to-end validation with live traffic before their procurement window closes.

Request (one-off, non-standard):
- Extend sandbox access from the standard 14 days to 60 days
- Provide a one-time complimentary compute credit equivalent to ~500k tokens (~$7,500 list cost)
- Temporary SLA variance: support the trial at 99.0% availability (we typically require 99.9%) until they go to paid capacity

Why this matters: Arboretum is in active procurement with a potential pilot ARR of $250k within 6 months; they require a longer validation window and an SLA carve to simulate their production latency/availability. Legal and security have reviewed the addendum (attached SOW draft) and SOC2 summary is included for their procurement team.

Next steps: if you’re comfortable with these terms, can you confirm in writing and I’ll escalate internally for one-time exec approval and coordinate a signed addendum + PO routing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft, addendum for one-off trial)
From: Elena Gomez <elena@arboretum.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway + SLA variance request for Arboretum Labs

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick follow. We can move fast on our side if Redwood can accommodate the requested runway and the temporary SLA variance. A couple of procurement items to confirm:

- We need a formal statement of work and a signed addendum showing the trial length and credits (your SOW draft looked good).
- Procurement requires SOC2 summary + any evidence of audit logs/retention policies (I attached a short list of ask items).
- Our finance team prefers a PO to reserve the extended sandbox; we can sign once legal confirms the addendum.

If you can escalate for exec approval on the credits and the 60-day window we’ll prioritize the PO and aim to start by Nov 1. This pilot is material to our roadmap and we’re planning a vendor decision in mid-December.

Thanks —
Elena Gomez
Head of Engineering
Arboretum Labs

Attachment: arb_procurment_req.docx (procurement checklist)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway + SLA variance request for Arboretum Labs

On Mon, Oct 26, 2026 at 10:14 AM Elena Gomez <elena@arboretum.ai> wrote:
> Marissa —
> 
> Thanks for the quick follow. We can move fast on our side if Redwood can accommodate the requested runway and the temporary SLA variance.

Team — quick summary and ask to expedite:
- ARR motion: Arboretum has signaled $250k ARR potential; strategic vertical (healthcare) and expected reference in Q1.
- Business case for waiver: procurement timeline tight; competitor A is offering a 45-day extended sandbox but without production latency characteristics. Winning them requires both time and an SLA carve so they can simulate failover testing.
- Cost estimate: 500k complimentary tokens ~ $7.5k; incremental operational support during the extended period (1x SRE on-call for onboarding).

If legal (Laura) is comfortable with the addendum and finance can approve a one-off credit memo (Sean), I'd like to escalate to Aditya for exec signoff on the one-time concession.

Proposed conditional approval template to send up:
- Approve up to $10k equivalent credits and up to 45-day extension OR up to $7.5k credits and 60-day extension (team choose tradeoff)
- Require signed addendum, PO, and a 1:1 onboarding with our SREs

Marissa — can you prepare a short exec note summarizing the ask and attach the commercial impact (lift vs. cost)?

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2026 07:55:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — one-off sandbox runway + SLA variance for Arboretum (ARB-2026-1043)

Aditya —

As discussed, I’m escalating a time-sensitive request for Arboretum Labs (deal ARB-2026-1043). They are in procurement and need an extended validation window to complete a production-like integration. If we don’t provide runway they will likely pilot with Competitor A.

Summary of ask (one-time, non-standard):
- Complimentary compute credit: 500k tokens (~$7.5k list cost)
- Sandbox extension: 60 days (standard is 14 days)
- Temporary SLA variance: 99.0% for the trial period (we will revert to standard SLA on paid contract)

Commercial rationale:
- Potential ARR: estimated $250k within 6 months if pilot converts
- Strategic value: healthcare reference, cross-sell into device integrations
- Cost of concession: nominal compared to expected ARR; we retain ability to gate conversion on PO and signed addendum

Compliance/legal: Laura has reviewed addendum and SOC2 summary (attached). Finance (Sean) can issue a credit memo conditioned on signed PO.

Requested decision: approve the above one-time concession so we can confirm terms with Arboretum and route a signed addendum + PO. If you’d prefer a smaller runway, Karthik recommends the tradeoff options below.

Tradeoff options (pick one):
A) Approve up to $10k credits, limit extension to 45 days
B) Approve $7.5k credits, allow full 60-day extension (current ask)

I can join a quick 15‑minute call if you want to review details.

Thanks for the quick read — timing is tight, procurement is ready to sign.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx; soc2_summary.pdf; sOW_draft_v1.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — one-off sandbox runway + SLA variance for Arboretum (ARB-2026-1043)

Marissa —

Appreciate the concise summary. Approve conditional one-time concession with the following constraints:

- Approve up to $10,000 equivalent credits OR up to 600k tokens (whichever is lower).
- Grant a 45-day sandbox extension (I prefer the shorter runway to limit open exposure).
- Temporary SLA variance to 99.0% for the trial period is acceptable but requires a clear rollback clause in the addendum (auto-revert to standard SLA upon paid contract).
- Require signed addendum and PO before credits are applied. Finance to issue a credit memo after PO is received (Sean, please confirm).
- Legal (Laura) to finalize the rollback language and confirm indemnity clauses.

Marissa/Karthik — please confirm you’ll send the signed addendum and PO link back to me once executed. If Arboretum insists on 60 days, escalate back with justification and we can review case-by-case.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

Forwarded-For-Record: Please route DocuSign link and HubSpot deal update once signed.
